description: Defines the 'entity_reference' data type class for Drupal, including methods for managing entity references, target definitions, and entity loading.

classes.name: EntityReference
classes.description: A data type class representing an entity reference, with methods to get target definitions, check if target is new, get target entity, set value, and get string representation.

methods.name: getTargetDefinition
methods.description: Returns the definition of the referenced entity.

methods.name: isTargetNew
methods.description: Checks if the target entity has not been saved yet.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Loads and returns the target entity's typed data if not already loaded.

methods.name: getTargetIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the entity ID or the entity's ID if available.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the reference value, accepting an entity object, ID, or null, and handles change notification.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns the label of the referenced entity or an empty string.
